cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Pull and build
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git pull origin main && pnpm run build 2>&1 | tail -5")
print("Build:", stdout.read().decode())

# Restart
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 restart areloria && sleep 12")
print("\nRestarted")

# Check ports
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ss -tlnp | grep -E '8080|3000'")
print("\nPorts:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
